thread:
alex: Heads up — CedarPay (prod, eu-west-1) reporting intermittent 5xx + tail-latency >10s on text-generation endpoints. Support ticket 8429. Saw surge around 10:22 UTC. Any immediate mitigation?
support-bot: Alert: 5xx-rate increased for model/gpt-neo-3.8 @ region eu-west-1 — 5m p95 9.8s, errors 4.7%
tara: I'm looking. Early signs point to request queue depth spiking and continuous-batcher backlog. Metrics: queue_depth ~ 420, batch_queue_length spikes to 40. Can someone pull traces?
kevin: grabbing traces — looks like KV cache warmups + long seq requests from CedarPay bulk job. Repro steps from support: curl with 100 concurrent short requests + 1 long seq every 10s. Logs attached.
sam-oncall: If batcher is backing up, we can temporarily lower batching window for CedarPay route to 10ms to shed latency. Propose deployment change. @ivy can you prep policy?
ivy: I can push a route override to reduce max_batch_delay and enforce small batch_size for their tenant. Will run canary on one host. ETA 12m.
alex: Meanwhile support asked for a repro we can run internally. Kevin, paste the minimal repro.
kevin: repro snippet:
```bash
for i in {1..100}; do curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.run/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-neo-3.8","input":"short prompt"}' &
  if (( i % 10 == 0 )); then 
    curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.run/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"gpt-neo-3.8","input":"<long prompt repeated 1500 tokens>"}' &
  fi
done
wait
```

tara: thanks. I see 504 on ingress gateway and then 502 from the runtime. Full traces indicate backlog in continuous-batcher: dequeue latency skyrockets when long seqs interleave. Queue depth hit configured tenant_limit 400.
sam-oncall: @ingress-bot temporarily applied tenant_queue_cap=200 for cedarpay-prod. Monitoring...
ingress-bot: Applied runtime override for tenant cedarpay-prod: tenant_queue_cap=200, max_batch_delay_ms=10. Rolling to 10% hosts.
ivy: Canary looks good — p95 dropped from 9.8s -> 1.4s on canary hosts. No increased error rate yet. Rolling remaining hosts.
kevin: Post-change logs show continuous-batcher backlog reduced. We should follow up with model suggestion: recommend quantized variant or request throttling for their bulk workers.
alex: Support to CedarPay: ask them to switch bulk exports to non-real-time/queue the long seq jobs. Also created follow-up ticket for product to consider tenant-level throttles + billing guardrails. :thumbsup: 
support-bot: Ticket 8429 updated: mitigation applied, monitoring windows stable. Marking thread for postmortem if recurrence.
